title: MappyDS.jl: Poincaré maps, periodic points and bifurcations of hybrid dynamical systems
description: Julia implementation of the mode concept (Miino, NOLTA IEICE 15(2), 2024): a hybrid or piecewise-smooth dynamical system is written as a graph of modes (ODE flows ending on a border, or discrete maps) and composed into a Poincaré map together with its Jacobian, Hessian, parameter derivatives and mixed second derivatives, which feed periodic-point search, local bifurcation analysis and parameter continuation. Julia counterpart of the Python package mappy-ds.
